# Sentopi

> Sentopi is a done-for-you weekly report on the five levers that run an Amazon brand: Operations, Pricing, Assortment, Visibility, and Ratings. Ratings is the deepest lever, because it is the feedback signal that reports on the other four, and it is where Sentopi's review analysis runs.

Sentopi calls the five levers the Retail Flywheel. Each week, Sentopi scores all five for a customer's product and returns a ranked action list: what to fix first, who owns it, and what the fix is worth in annual revenue. The Ratings layer goes deepest, reading every review and mapping each complaint to a root cause, because that is where customers say in their own words which of the other four levers is leaking. The differentiator is financial context: every finding carries a revenue impact estimate rather than a bare sentiment score. Nothing is self-serve to operate. The customer sets up nothing and runs nothing.

## Key facts

- What it is: a done-for-you weekly report on the Retail Flywheel, the five levers that run an Amazon brand (Operations, Pricing, Assortment, Visibility, Ratings), delivered per product with a ranked, priced fix list.
- Deepest lever: Ratings. It is the feedback signal that reports on the other four, so Sentopi reads every review and maps each complaint to a root cause (listing accuracy, product, or operations) rather than stopping at a sentiment score.
- Cadence is the product: the report recurs weekly. A one-off report is the free sample. The weekly loop is what customers pay for.
- Done for you: there is nothing to set up, no integration, and no dashboard to operate. Sentopi gathers, reads, and scores everything and sends the report.
- Free instrument: the Revenue Risk Report scores all five levers live from public Amazon data for any ASIN or Seller ID, in about 30 seconds, with no email required. The first full product report is also free.
- Pricing: $149 per month per product for the recurring weekly report. That is the only monthly price.
- Differentiator: financial context. Every issue is tied to a dollar impact estimate.
- Original research finding: across 3,725 Amazon reviews spanning 7 brands in 4 categories, 40 to 55 percent of 1-star reviews trace to listing accuracy problems rather than product failures.
- Free tools: five instant tools and diagnostics with no email gate. The Revenue Risk Report scores all five Retail Flywheel levers for a single ASIN or Seller ID, the Sales Drop Diagnostic forks a sales drop into traffic, conversion, or stockout from the seller's own Seller Central numbers, the Star Rating Calculator models what a rating improvement is worth on the Ratings lever. The first full product analysis is also free.
- Founders: Oliver Silen and An Luong, with 10+ years in retail and ecommerce at companies including Amazon and Walmart.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://sentopi.com/): The Retail Flywheel, the five levers a brand runs on, and how to score them free.
- [Revenue Risk Report](https://sentopi.com/revenue-risk-report): Free instrument. Paste an ASIN or Seller ID to score the levers from public Amazon data, with the revenue at risk in dollars. No email required.
- [Free Tools hub](https://sentopi.com/tools): Index of all Sentopi free tools. Instant diagnostics with methodology shown, and the first output never costs an email.
- [Sales Drop Diagnostic](https://sentopi.com/sales-drop-diagnostic): Free interactive tool. Enter sessions and conversion rate for two windows to get the traffic-or-conversion verdict, ranked causes with the exact check for each, and an estimated revenue gap.
- [Star Rating Calculator](https://sentopi.com/star-rating-calculator): Free calculator for the Ratings lever. Enter rating, review count, and revenue to see how many 5-star reviews reach a target rating and the conversion and revenue lift on the way there.
- [The Growth Loop](https://sentopi.com/growth-loop): The framework behind the weekly report. The five levers every Amazon brand runs on (Operations, Pricing, Assortment, Visibility, Ratings), run as a continuous loop, with benchmarks for each.
- [Listing Accuracy Research](https://sentopi.com/listing-accuracy): Original study of 3,725 Amazon reviews across 7 brands in 4 categories, finding that 40-55% of 1-star reviews trace to listing accuracy problems rather than product failures.
- [Why Are My Amazon Sales Down](https://sentopi.com/why-are-my-amazon-sales-down): Five-minute diagnostic for a sudden Amazon sales drop: the sessions-versus-conversion fork, then the five most common causes with what to check for each.
- [Why Did I Lose the Buy Box](https://sentopi.com/lost-buy-box): Diagnostic for the Operations and Pricing levers.
- [Why Are My Amazon Reviews Not Showing Up](https://sentopi.com/amazon-reviews-not-showing-up): Diagnostic for the Ratings lever.
- [Pet Wellness Review Complaints](https://sentopi.com/pet-wellness-review-complaints): Original research from a 1,638-review pilot: complaint taxonomy, efficacy-gap decomposition, and the listing-versus-operations split.
- [Guides hub](https://sentopi.com/guides): Index of all Sentopi guides and research for Amazon brands.
